rationale: cdp-use is a type-safe Python client generator for the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). It auto-generates ~50 domain-specific client classes with TypedDict type safety from official CDP specs. The core CDPClient provides async WebSocket communication, command/response handling, and a typed event registration system. This directly implements browser-automation at the low-level protocol tier. B tier assigned due to low-level CDP scope without high-level automation/scraping orchestrations.
limitations: Low-level CDP protocol binding requires higher-level framework for full scraping tasks
